description: Compares two sources of the MORVS U.S. Forced Labor Company Register: the DHS UFLPA Entity List (dhs), CBP withhold release orders and findings (cbp), and the Consolidated Screening List rows that exactly match a DHS or CBP name (csl). Returns the entity ids named in both sources under the register's reviewed name and alias joins, the ids in source_a with no reviewed match in source_b and the reverse, with counts, the register's own published overlap figures, the source rows behind each listed entity (source URL, row locator, snapshot date) and each source's snapshot date, in pages of up to 50 ids per list continued with next_cursor. Issuers linked only through a filing are never counted, so a parent never enters an overlap. The sources apply different laws; an entity with no reviewed match in the other source reads "No reviewed name or alias match in this source snapshot", which is not a clearance finding.

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from an earlier page with the same sources; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum entity ids per list on one page; default 50, max 50.

source_a.description: First source: dhs (UFLPA Entity List), cbp (CBP WROs and Findings) or csl (matched Consolidated Screening List rows).

source_b.description: Second source, different from source_a: dhs, cbp or csl. Lists are reported as a without b and b without a.

name: forced_labor_source_compare
title: Compare Forced Labor Register Sources
